title: Why walk when you can bike?
text: Would highly recommend this bike tour to anyone. We are in Barcelona for only a limited time and wanted to see as much as we could in the few days. Went on this bike tour and it became one of the highlights. Mariana our tour guide was fantastic! She catered the tour to our abilities ( we are avid riders) and adjusted the tour to what we wanted to see. We biked through  the Gothic quarter, visited Olympic stadium and pool and did some sight seeing in the Mont Juic area! We also stopped for a great cup of coffee and traditional pastries ! Everything was terrific!
author: L6773GWmc

title: A great way to see the gothic quarter and beyond.
text:
A fun tour that took us all around Barcelona to so many sights we would have never found on our own.
Riding an ebike was an easy way to see many of the great Barcelona sights. The tour lasted 4 hrs and made time for stops at several places including for snacks and a closer look at some of the attractions. Our guide Augustin was knowledgeable, friendly and humorous.
Really enjoyed it. Totally worth it.
author: 602katie

title: Ophelie was a great tour guide!
text: My husband and I really enjoyed our off the beaten track bicycle tour with Ophelie. I have never been to Barcelona before and wanted to learn about less touristy areas and explore lesser known areas. Going on this trip early in our time here really helped me to get a better mental map of the city and learn what areas of town I wanted to spend more time in. Ophelie was very knowledgeable and we stopped often  during our four-hour tour to learn about history, architecture, and landmarks. She was also friendly and a great conversationalist. title: Wonderful day
text: Get to places on two wheels you wouldn’t have otherwise. So fun riding through the city! Alejandra was terrific.
author: Krista_G

title: What a great way to be introduced to Barcelona!
text:
How wonderful to get to ride with and be guided by Alejandra on our first day in and first trip to Barcelona!
And by bike was ideal.
Love the locations she chose and the important local Barcelona regional Catalonia history and touchstones she shared. From in person views to print photos from her guide book.
She also went above and beyond in sharing photos, videos, and restaurant recommendations with us after our tour.
: )
author: 999shaynar

title: Afternoon in Barcelona.
text: Ale was a great guide - passionate and knowledgeable about Barcelona and a good sense of fun. We really enjoyed getting to know Barcelona on our first day this way so we could get a sense of where we wanted to go to visit again, and to also become familiar with it. The stop for tapas at the end was very welcome!! Thanks so much Ale for a really wonderful experience.
author: Emma J

title: Great city bike tour
text: Exceptional tour. Good quality bikes. We had e-bikes. Julio was a great tour host and informative. Great sight stops and very varied.
author: jass849

title: Fun bike tour with Alejandra
text: Alejandra was a fantastic guide for our family! She was friendly, knowledgeable, and fun. She showed us interesting places we wouldn’t have found on our own and shared Catalan history and culture with us. Thank you for a great afternoon!
author: Companion25659575766

title: Memorable bike tour with Alejandra
text: We spent a wonderful bike tour with Alejandra! All along the afternoon, she passed on to us her passion for this multi-faceted city and we got to see Barcelona spots we would’ve thought of visiting. We learned lots along the way on life in the city, history and street-art. The stop for tapas in Els Sortidor del Parliament was an even nicer touch to this active afternoon.
author: feliciad383

title: Excellent introduction to Barcelona!
text: This was an amazing tour! Such a fun way to learn about the city. Our guide, Austin, was fantastic!! Organized, kind, with such a fun and informative lens on Barcelona. I would highly recommend!
